name: Md Rejoan Hasan

As a Supervisor in Core IT, I have personally observed how carefully they manage planning, coordination, and execution—always paying attention to the smallest details and ensuring timely delivery. Their teamwork, client support, and service quality truly set them apart. I believe Ananta Events and Entertainment Bangladesh will continue to achieve greater milestones and establish itself as one of the leading names in the country’s event management industry.
